verdict.overall: Since Sunday nearly every name has pulled back, led by BE (-7.7%), AMAT (-5.5%) and PLTR (-4.5%), with support floors sinking in several chains (AMAT, PLTR, BE) and ceilings compressing lower across the board. SPY and QQQ remain the steadiest range setups for swing trades, holding neutral all the way out, though NVDA's earnings this Tuesday and AVGO's on Dec 9 add event risk inside this window. Confidence in the calmer setups (SPY, QQQ, and now AVGO/GOOGL where some opposing scores softened to neutral) is holding up better than the weaker, fast-falling names like BE, AMAT and PLTR.
